summary: Ephemeral CLI token creation failing after CA cert-chain rotation blocks analytics CLI and portal
description:
Issue summary:
After an internal CA/intermediate certificate rotation performed 2026-03-12 02:00 UTC, ephemeral CLI token creation and web token exchange began failing for the analytics tooling. Users report being unable to authenticate via CLI (analytics-cli) and being redirected back to an error page when signing into the analytics console.

Impact:
- ~25 engineers reported failures to run analytics-cli commands for morning triage (unable to obtain ephemeral tokens).
- Web logins to analytics console intermittently show an auth callback 500 and leave users on an 'Authentication error' page.
- Affects primarily prod us-west; sporadic failures observed in prod us-east.

Environment:
- Affected services: auth-proxy (idp-proxy), identity-bridge (token exchange), analytics-console, scim-sync for service-account lookups.
- Platforms: Kubernetes clusters in us-west-2 and us-east-1.

Steps to reproduce:
1) Attempt CLI login: `redwood auth login --cli analytics`
2) Observe token exchange error and no ephemeral token created.
3) Attempt web login to analytics console -> redirect to /auth/callback -> 500 error page.

Observed/log excerpts (sanitized):
- auth-proxy stderr: `2026-03-12T02:17:06Z ERROR upstream tls handshake failed: remote error: unknown_ca`
- identity-bridge logs: `ERR token-exchange: verify_assertion: x509: certificate signed by unknown authority`
- analytics-console: `WARN session: token exchange failed: status=502 body="upstream TLS: EOF"`
- nginx-ingress (us-west): `[error] 12345#0: *98765 recv() failed (104: Connection reset by peer) while reading response header from upstream`

Initial hypothesis:
- Intermediate certs were rotated but the renewed leaf cert chains were deployed without the intermediate certificate, causing Okta or internal TLS verification to fail during the token-exchange handshake.
- Auth-proxy trusts the new CA bundle; however one of the internal components (identity-bridge) rejects the presented client cert because the chain is incomplete.

Temporary impact mitigation requested by support: escalate to SRE and the identity team to avoid extended downtime for internal tooling.
comments: 2026-03-12 08:11 - Aisha Patel (Reporter): Noticed CLI auth broke after the scheduled cert rotation. Multiple teammates hitting the same failure. Opening ticket and tagging identity/sre.

2026-03-12 08:35 - Mateo Rivera (Assigned): Investigating. Can you capture full auth-proxy logs for 02:10-02:30 UTC? Also please attach the ingress cert chain shown by curl -v to the auth-proxy endpoint.

2026-03-12 09:02 - SRE (Jordan Li): Got logs. auth-proxy presents leaf cert but upstream (identity-bridge) returns unknown_ca. Reproduced locally by issuing TLS handshake to identity-bridge and observing missing intermediate in presented chain.

2026-03-12 10:20 - Identity Team (Priya Nair): Confirmed CA rotation job (automation/cert-rotator) deployed new leaf certs to auth-proxy but intermediate bundle was trimmed by the template. Preparing fix to re-deploy full chain across services.

2026-03-12 11:05 - Mateo Rivera: Applied hotfix to re-deploy full cert chain to identity-bridge in us-west cluster. Observed successful token exchange in canary. Rolling to rest of cluster. Please validate client logins.
2026-03-12 11:22 - Affected User (Evan Brooks): Confirmed analytics-cli login succeeded after hotfix. Web login to analytics console also works now for me. Thanks.
investigation_notes: Verification steps: captured TLS handshake to identity-bridge (openssl s_client -showcerts) showed only leaf certificate presented; intermediate missing. Cert-rotator job logs show post-rotate step used `concat_chain=false` in template, which caused intermediate omission. Reproduction: applied incomplete chain to a staging identity-bridge and observed token-exchange failures identical to production errors. Relevant config: automation/cert-rotator v2.1.4; helm chart values had `tls.chainInclude: false` introduced in recent chart bump.
resolution_notes:
Hotfix: re-deployed affected services with full cert bundle (leaf + intermediate + root where required). Performed rolling restart of identity-bridge and auth-proxy in us-west, then us-east. Post-deploy verification: repeated CLI login and web login flows succeeded; token-exchange errors subsided in logs.

Permanent fix: update cert-rotator templates to always include intermediate(s) and add a post-rotate TLS-verify smoke test that performs token-exchange against identity-bridge before finalizing rotation. Patch PRs created (see related_github_prs).

Follow-ups: see next_steps.
next_steps: 1) Merge PR to cert-rotator to force chain inclusion and add post-rotate test (owner: Priya). 2) Add CI job to run TLS chain verification against a staging identity-bridge (owner: SRE). 3) Run a retrospective with automation/identity/auth teams and update rotation runbook to include additional verification steps. 4) Customer-facing communication not required (internal-only).
